incidents.title: Oil Tanker On Fire After Hitting Mine In Hormuz

incidents.title: Gulf war leaves toxic legacy that could last decades
incidents.description: Greenpeace has identified 540 possible oil spills across the Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Arabian Sea since the US-Iran war began on February 28 (see map below), with satellite imagery showing a cumulative slick footprint of approximately 20,000 sq km.
